text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(It's quiet. So very quiet—and yet, 
everyone's raw excitement ripples through 
the air...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Here, where nothing stands in the way... 
All I feel is anticipation, heat, and—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'm—gonna winnnnn!! 
HAAAAAAAAAH!!"

The moment they tore across the finish 
line, 
light broke through the 
clouds—illuminating the victor.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: She won......!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Almond Eye!! 
Limitlessly strong, limitlessly beautiful! 
She crowns her career in absolute glory!

Daring Tact had been defeated. 
Along with the sting of frustration—an 
overwhelming sense of awe surged forth for 
Almond Eye, who raced to the very end as 
the undisputed strongest.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap......!!)

The spectators, too, were united as one— 
sending thunderous applause to the 
horsegirl 
who had achieved a glorious victory in the 
pinnacle race.
choice_data_list:
(And that's precisely why it stings so 
much...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haah... gh, haah... gh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(So this is—the reigning horsegirl at the 
pinnacle of strength, Almond Eye...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... She's so strong... 
Almond Eye is just incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye... Thank you for giving us so 
many dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (...Some people are even crying.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Almond Eye's strength, her dazzling 
brilliance—it touched everyone's hearts.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Her back feels so impossibly far away...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...What an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"...It's still far away. For now. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer... 
I'm so sorry."
choice_data_list: No, you were strong out there too.
No, you were strong out there too.

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact had shown a performance truly 
worthy of a reigning Triple Tiara 
champion. However—
choice_data_list:
As of right now, our opponent was just too 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"From your perspective, Trainer... what 
was the difference between Almond Eye and 
me?"

After claiming the Triple Tiara, Almond 
Eye ventured into the classic 
middle-distance route and overseas, 
blazing a trail that was entirely her own.
choice_data_list:
I think it was the difference in what 
she's built over time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Do you believe that with more experience, 
I too... 
can become a horsegirl that anyone would 
call 
"overwhelmingly strong"?

It was, without a doubt, the sprouting of 
ambition. 
Through this very race, Daring Tact had 
awakened— 
to her pride as a "champion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you think I can... 
become a more certain, unwavering light?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to let things end here. 
I want to win on an even greater stage.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not just as a horsegirl 
from Hidaka, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—as the Triple Tiara horsegirl everyone 
cheered for... 
I want to show them an even grander 
dream...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please help me think of one. 
A path where I can shine even brighter...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! 
Hey, let's race again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...? But Almond Eye, you're—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I mean, your fighting spirit... was 
incredible! 
Next time definitely won't end up like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back for sure. 
So—get stronger, and wait for me!

While Daring Tact was getting ready, 
I considered several paths she could take 
for her Senior Year. The conclusion was—
choice_data_list: I'd like us to focus on the classic route.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... targeting races like 
today's? 
Aiming for premier medium-distance events?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, because they draw the most 
attention.

Yeah, because they draw the most 
attention.

text_block_list.text:
Of course, I still intend for her to run 
the Tiara route. 
However, she can't be contained by just 
that—
choice_data_list: Let's go beyond the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Beyond...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I want to reach it. 
Please lead the way!

That said, Daring Tact has spent this past 
year 
in intense battles, claiming the Triple 
Tiara 
and facing her seniors. First, a rest is 
in order—
choice_data_list:
Let's kick things off with the Kinko Sho 
in March.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You were careful about spacing out 
my races during my Junior Year as well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Right now, I can believe 
that taking my time is the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you again 
next year!

title: After the Japan Cup: A Distant Back
